hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that integrates with Euler Finance vaults. It handles all swap execution in beforeSwap using a custom bonding curve: input tokens are deposited into an Euler vault and output tokens are withdrawn from another, with the hook returning a BeforeSwapDelta. Direct liquidity provision and donations to the underlying pool are intentionally blocked.
